mapper.insert: MERGE INTO inventory_sync_run_source target USING (SELECT CAST(#{runId} AS NUMBER) AS run_id, source_type, current_version FROM inventory_source_state) source ON (target.inventory_sync_run_id = source.run_id AND target.source_type = source.source_type) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.start_version = source.current_version, target.end_version = NULL, target.source_status = 'PENDING', target.read_count = 0, target.mapped_count = 0, target.changed_count = 0, target.error_count = 0, target.started_at = NULL, target.completed_at = NULL WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (inventory_sync_run_id, source_type, start_version, source_status) VALUES (source.run_id, source.source_type, source.current_version, 'PENDING')

MERGE INTO inventory_sync_run_source target USING (SELECT CAST(#{runId} AS NUMBER) AS inventory_sync_run_id, CAST(#{sourceType} AS VARCHAR2(20)) AS source_type, CAST(#{startVersion} AS NUMBER) AS start_version FROM dual) source ON (target.inventory_sync_run_id = source.inventory_sync_run_id AND target.source_type = source.source_type) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.start_version = source.start_version, target.end_version = NULL, target.source_status = 'RUNNING', target.read_count = 0, target.mapped_count = 0, target.changed_count = 0, target.error_count = 0, target.started_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, target.completed_at = NULL WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( inventory_sync_run_id, source_type, start_version, source_status, started_at ) VALUES (source.inventory_sync_run_id, source.source_type, source.start_version, 'RUNNING', SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_sync_run_source SET source_status = 'FAILED', completed_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE inventory_sync_run_id = #{runId} AND source_status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
